name: Shopify price and stock changes to Slack (daily)

parameters.content:
## Set these 3 things before the first run

1. **Apify token**: open *Run Shopify Store Scraper*, create a **Header Auth** credential named `Apify API token` with Name `Authorization` and Value `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN` (token: Apify Console > Settings > API & Integrations).
2. **Slack**: open *Send Slack message*, connect Slack, and replace `#replace-with-your-channel` with your channel. No Slack? Disable that node and enable *Send Email (alternative to Slack)* (needs an SMTP credential and your addresses).
3. **Stores**: edit `storeUrls` in the JSON body of the HTTP node (bare domain, myshopify domain or a collection URL).

The first run labels every variant `new` (it creates the baseline) and sends one message with the first 40. After that you get a message only when a price, stock status or the catalog changed.

## 300-second limit

Apify's `run-sync-get-dataset-items` endpoint answers **408 after 300 seconds** (node timeout 310 s). One mid-size store finishes in a few seconds. `maxProductsPerStore: 1000` keeps the default bounded; a store that hits the cap is not read completely, so `removed` rows are held back. For very large stores, use Apify's async run endpoint or an Apify schedule instead.

`maxTotalChargeUsd=0.25` in the query caps the cost of one run.

Uses the Shopify Store Scraper Actor by Cedarfetch Labs on Apify (pay per result).
https://apify.com/cedarfetch/shopify-store-scraper

nodes.name: Change row or store problem?
nodes.notes: False branch: nothing changed (the HTTP node passes one empty item), so nothing is sent.
